title: Before and after, as evidence
label: A results card with three metric rows from one operations team, read the quarter before a new workflow. A horizontal divider moves down the card one row at a time; as it passes each row, the before value is replaced by the after value with the change beside it and a bar that shrinks or grows from the old length, which stays as a dashed outline. Tools in use go from six to one, down eighty-three percent; time a week on requests from four hours ten minutes to twelve minutes, down ninety-five percent; requests with an owner from three of nine to nine of nine, up six. A short quote from the customer's head of operations closes it. Then the divider returns to the top.
heading:
Same team.
Next quarter.
sub: Three numbers from one ops team: the quarter before the workflow, and the quarter after.

quote.text: We stopped asking who has it. The queue tells us, and payroll hasn't slipped since.
quote.name: Dana Okafor
